scope: Native real body walking; app commands, synthetic E press/release through the real application input handler and actual menu Button signals. Legal reverse division, two passengers at distinct supports, same MemoryRepository save/continuation without history, open-menu automatic beats and real stage-edge/reunion-stair reset probes. Each reverse/two-passenger/edge/stair reset compares bodies, runtime poses and facing with the original trial (XZ <= 1cm; floor solver Y <= 3cm). Original 27-intention fixture replayed unchanged at 1280x720 and 844x390. No actor/snapshot injection or teleport; no fixed screenshot total. AudioStub retained, so this suite does not validate audio, OS-level touch, browser input or Web performance. Screenshots wait actual GPU draws without advancing application ticks.
